searchText: I am doing some history digging, and EIP-7 for example ``` // Specification of EIP-7 DELEGATECALL: 0xf4, takes 6 operands: ... in_offset: the offset into memory of the input; in_size: the size of the input in bytes; ... ``` In what way is client implementation determining the data type and size of the `in_offset` and `in_size`?
